notes: Pointer to the invention's Markush class, named on line 153 as Die Verbindungen der allgemeinen Formel I in the stereoisomer paragraph, and referred to again in the same paragraph as von der allgemeinen Formel I umfasst. Formula I is defined elsewhere in the document, so this is a reference and not a specific structure: resolved false, unresolved_reference true. Line 120's In Formel (I) und allen nachfolgenden Formeln points at the formula rather than at compounds and is not emitted separately; the two mentions are one record. The rest of this section is Markush definition prose only. Every other chemical name in it is an R-group substituent fragment (Alkyl, Halogenalkyl, CF3, OCH2CF3, Fluor/Chlor/Brom/Iod as the meanings of Halogen) or a ring name used to define the Aryl, Cycloalkyl, Heterocyclyl and Heteroaryl classes, so none is emitted under rule 8.
